request.style: English, roots reggae, one drop drums, deep round bass line, offbeat guitar skank, bubbling organ, warm male lead with female harmony singers, a song of freedom, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Down in the dungeon, feet in the stocks
Paul and Silas behind the locks
Around midnight they began to pray
Singing hymns to God, and the prisoners heard them that day

[Chorus]
And the chains fell loose, the doors flew open
Every prison shook, every chain was broken
Sing at midnight, sing in the night
Till the morning comes with the light

[Verse]
The jailer woke and he drew his sword
Do not harm yourself, we are all here, said Paul
What must I do to be saved, he cried
Believe in the Lord Jesus and you'll be saved, they replied

[Chorus]
And the chains fell loose, the doors flew open
Every prison shook, every chain was broken
Sing at midnight, sing in the night
Till the morning comes with the light
